mapper.insert:
insert into order_protect
order_no, user_id, org_id, volunteer_id, species_id, quantity, amount, status, address, execute_images, create_time,
#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{orgId}, #{volunteerId}, #{speciesId}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{address}, #{executeImages}, sysdate(),
mapper.select: select id, order_no, user_id, org_id, volunteer_id, species_id, quantity, amount, status, address, execute_images, pay_time, complete_time, create_time, update_time from order_protect where order_no = #{orderNo}
select count(1) from order_protect where org_id = #{orgId} and status = 1
select count(1) from order_protect where org_id = #{orgId} and status in (2, 3) and DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
select count(1) from order_protect where org_id = #{orgId} and status = 4
select count(1) from order_protect where org_id = #{orgId} and status = 5
select count(1) from order_protect where org_id = #{orgId} and status = 6

select.if:
select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COUNT(*) as value, 'orders' as metric from order_protect where create_time is not null
and create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
group by DATE(create_time) order by date

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%u') as date, COUNT(*) as value, 'orders' as metric from order_protect where create_time is not null
and create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
group by YEARWEEK(create_time) order by date

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, COUNT(*) as value, 'orders' as metric from order_protect where create_time is not null
and create_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00')
and create_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59')
group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') order by date

mapper.select: select s.name, COUNT(op.species_id) as value from order_protect op USE INDEX (idx_species_id) inner join species s on op.species_id = s.id where op.species_id is not null group by s.id, s.name order by value desc limit 20
select org_id as id, CONCAT('机构-', org_id) as name, COUNT(*) as value, 0 as rank from order_protect USE INDEX (idx_org_id) where org_id is not null group by org_id order by value desc limit #{limit}

select id, order_no, user_id, org_id, volunteer_id, species_id, quantity, amount, status, address, execute_images, pay_time, complete_time, create_time, update_time from order_protect where id = #{id}
